summary: Produced a compiling TikZ reconstruction (version 2) that passed topology and received a Critic score of 0.95 with no open issues. It draws triangle ABC with named paths A--D--B, A--E--C and B--H--C; a dashed altitude A--H; the solid square D--E--F--G; and the solid segment B--G. All eight labels A-H are present. Version 1 failed topology (six unverified side edges), and the repair fixed that.
